function.name: execute_bash

content:
export LDFLAGS="${CFLAGS}"
export CMAKE_C_FLAGS="${CC} ${CFLAGS}"
export CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="${CXX} ${CXXFLAGS}"
mkdir build-dir
cd build-dir
cmake -G "Unix Makefiles"     -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Release     -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS:BOOL=OFF     -DBUILD_TESTING:BOOL=OFF     -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILES:BOOL=ON     -DHDF5_BUILD_EXAMPLES:BOOL=OFF     -DHDF5_BUILD_TOOLS:BOOL=OFF     -DHDF5_ENABLE_SANITIZERS:BOOL=ON     -DHDF5_ENABLE_Z_LIB_SUPPORT:BOOL=ON     ..
cmake --build . --verbose --config Release -j$(nproc)
cd $SRC/hdf5
$CC $CFLAGS  -std=c99 -c   -I/src/hdf5/src -I/src/hdf5/build-dir/src -I./src/H5FDsubfiling/   $SRC/h5_read_fuzzer.c
$CXX $CXXFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE h5_read_fuzzer.o ./build-dir/bin/libhdf5.a -lz -o $OUT/h5_read_fuzzer
$CC $CFLAGS  -std=c99 -c   -I/src/hdf5/src -I/src/hdf5/build-dir/src -I./src/H5FDsubfiling/   $SRC/h5_extended_fuzzer.c
$CXX $CXXFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE h5_extended_fuzzer.o ./build-dir/bin/libhdf5.a -lz -o $OUT/h5_extended_fuzzer
zip -j $OUT/h5_extended_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/hdf5/test/*.h5
